changelog: Live trade display (Part C of the original v3.22.1 briefing, moved forward to this release) -- pending limit orders and open positions now draw their own full-width Entry/Limit/SL/TP lines, $ pills, and (for an open position) a fill-to-cursor box with a live Open P&L / R-multiple centre pill, all drawn from the session's own open_positions/pending_orders, never from the order ticket -- this is the actual fix for 'after Place Trade, every line disappears.' A closed trade leaves a faint entry/exit arrow + R-multiple marker and fires a 'Trade closed: {+/-$} ({R})' toast. The drawing that placed an order is hidden permanently once linked (new backtest_drawings.linked_trade_id/linked_order_id columns) so the chart never shows the same trade twice. A new header strip (Equity / Target / Loss) is always visible on the replay screen.

Fix A: every text node in the Open Positions and Pending Orders rows now has an explicit dark-theme colour -- the live report's Pending Orders row showed only its Cancel button because its own <span> had no colour and fell through to the light-theme default.

Fix B: every user-entered price is rounded to a believable number of decimals (symbol-free bucketed rule, same one fmtPrice5() already used for display) before it's shown in a ticket input, used in a pill, or submitted -- both client and server side. Internal math still runs at full precision.

Fix C: the sidebar's New Trade button is disabled at the daily trade cap with the cap reason as its own label; the toolbar's Place Trade stays clickable for planning per the briefing's own carve-out; the ticket itself shows the cap reason as a banner at the TOP, and the cap check now runs first in the ticket's own blocking-reason chain.

Fix D: fixed in four layers, the last one found only by the browser harness, not by inspection. (1) getSession() never passed a mark price to computeSessionState(), so every open position priced itself at its own entry (zero gross P&L) instead of the current bar's close. (2) currentBar() hardcoded a 15-minute candle for the market-fill/close price regardless of the cursor's own actual resolution, which is also why a live fill (7140) matched neither the ticket's displayed entry nor anything the trader saw -- now reads the cursor's own cursor_step_tf, so the two can never disagree again. (3) advance()'s own 'no more bars to replay' branch omitted open_positions/pending_orders entirely, and the client's res.open_positions||[] fallback silently emptied the panel once replay reached the end of history -- exactly the live report's own symptom. (4) js/calculator.js independently declares its own global renderOpenPositions(), which silently overwrote backtest.js's own same-named function (later <script> tag wins in a shared global scope) for the ENTIRE page's lifetime -- every call anywhere in the app was running the calculator's version, which never touched the backtest panel at all. Renamed to renderBtOpenPositions().

Fix E (critical): settleTrade() wrote wall-clock 'now' for every closed backtest trade's time_out instead of the replay bar that actually closed it, which silently broke rewind() -- it reopens trades by comparing time_out against the new cursor, and a time_out stuck in 2026 made any rewind reopen the trader's entire closed-trade history. Now takes the real exit bar's time from all three callers. A new one-off data-repair migration backfills existing rows by finding the earliest candle whose range actually touched the recorded exit price, logged permanently to a new backtest_exit_time_repairs_log table.

Fix F: a double-click placed two identical market orders on the same bar with nothing on screen confirming the first had gone through. Place Trade is now disabled for the whole round trip and shows a real fill confirmation toast on success. Server-side, a second order with identical direction/SL/TP placed within 5 seconds is now rejected outright as a duplicate.

tools/ui-harness/ extended (not rebuilt) with a stateful mock for three new session ids, deterministic O(1) candle generation (replacing the legacy per-request random walk, which could describe the same bar two different ways depending on the request window), and a real history floor so candle pagination can actually exhaust. New drive-v3223.mjs: 21 assertions covering the acceptance criterion and the full Verify 1-4 flow end to end. The original drive.mjs (v3.22.2, session 6) is untouched and still passes all 15 of its own assertions.

Duplicate top-level name scan added to the harness (scan-duplicate-names.mjs, a real acorn AST walk, not a regex guess) after an explicit pre-release audit -- found that js/backtest.js and js/report-card.js independently declare their own escapeHtml(), identical collision shape to the renderOpenPositions() one in Fix D, just not yet causing visible breakage (report-card.js's own more-complete regex version, loaded after backtest.js, was already the one silently winning for both files). Consolidated into one copy in js/app.js, removed from both old homes. The scan now runs as the first assertion in both harness drivers, so a future same-name collision anywhere in app/js/ fails loudly instead of silently shadowing a function again.

Fixed while re-verifying the above: js/app.js's toast() never cancelled its own previous hide timer, so two toasts shown within 2.8 seconds of each other could clip each other's visible time unpredictably -- found as an intermittent harness failure (Verify 3's toast check), real on live too. One timer at a time now.
release_notes: One new migration, 2026_10_01_0002_add_backtest_drawing_links.sql (two guarded ADD COLUMNs + two guarded FKs on backtest_drawings), plus a one-off data-repair migration, 2026_10_01_0001_repair_backtest_wall_clock_time_out.sql, for existing backtest trades with a wall-clock time_out (Fix E) -- export the database before running mode=run, per the usual migration rule. Verified end-to-end in a real browser via tools/ui-harness/drive-v3223.mjs (see CLAUDE.md's v3.22.3 section): the acceptance criterion (pre-seeded open positions + pending order show their lines immediately on open), Fix A/B/C, and the full Verify 1-4 flow (place/cancel a Limit order, place a Market order and watch its lines+box+P&L pill update across Next Bar, advance to a pre-computed TP hit and see the marker+toast, rewind past the close). Fix E's own 'rewind reopens the right trades' server-side guarantee is verified by code review, not the harness (no DB in this environment, same long-standing limitation) -- the trader should confirm it live before trusting it fully. php -l, node --check, and backtest_engine.php's self-test (48 assertions) all clean.
